description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The application ID, which is created and queried in the console. Only a single ID can be specified.
The configuration template ID. To obtain the template ID, see [AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~).

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~)添加录制配置模板。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes
Before you call this operation, you must call [AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~) to add a recording configuration template.
# QPS limit
The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call the operation reasonably. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~341645~~).
